summary: Google released Gemini 4 Argon for enterprise work and developers on October 13, describing long document synthesis, finance reconciliations, legal citations and guarded cybersecurity tasks. Its public model identifier is gemini-4-argon. Introductory API prices run through November 30 before doubling. Customer results and benchmark scores in the launch post are vendor reported, not independently verified.
why_it_matters: Knowledge workers should evaluate one bounded reconciliation or legal-source task with fixed inputs, citation checks, explicit error handling and human signoff. Finance teams should model token costs under both introductory and later pricing before committing a workflow.
related_coverage: See companion October 14 coverage for engineering, responsible tasks, knowledge context and safe skills.
image_alt_intent: Long-document evidence assembly feeding Gemini Argon financial reconciliation and legal citation checks; independent formula/citation evaluator and approval checkpoint, with November pricing shift and usage-budget ledger.
